#!/bin/bash
# Count approximate fan-in for package-level funcs declared under internal/
cd /bench/repo

: > /tmp/fanin_funcs.txt

while IFS='|' read -r file pkg dir; do
  # package-level funcs only (skip methods with receivers)
  grep -n '^func [A-Za-z_]' "$file" | while IFS= read -r hit; do
    line=${hit#*:}
    body=${line#*:}
    name=$(echo "$body" | sed -n 's/^func \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/p')
    [ -z "$name" ] && continue

    # cross-package qualified calls: pkg.Name(
    cross=$(grep -rho --include='*.go' "\b${pkg}\.${name}(" . | wc -l)

    # same-package unqualified calls within the package dir, excluding declarations
    same=$(grep -rho --include='*.go' "\b${name}(" "$dir" | wc -l)
    decls=$(grep -rho --include='*.go' "^func ${name}(" "$dir" | wc -l)
    same=$((same - decls))
    [ "$same" -lt 0 ] && same=0

    total=$((cross + same))
    echo "$total|$name|$file|cross=$cross|same=$same" >> /tmp/fanin_funcs.txt
  done
done < /tmp/filepkg.txt

sort -t'|' -k1,1nr /tmp/fanin_funcs.txt | head -40

#!/bin/bash
# Accurate-ish fan-in for package-level funcs declared under internal/
cd /bench/repo

: > /tmp/fanin2.txt

# qualifier aliases per package dir
qual_for() {
  case "$1" in
    internal/markdown/ast) echo "ast mast" ;;
    internal/markdown/parser) echo "parser mparser" ;;
    internal/ai/stt/openai) echo "openai sttopenai" ;;
    internal/ai/audiollm/gemini) echo "gemini audiollmgemini" ;;
    *) basename "$1" ;;
  esac
}

while IFS='|' read -r file pkg dir; do
  quals=$(qual_for "$dir")
  grep -n '^func [A-Za-z_]' "$file" | while IFS= read -r hit; do
    body=${hit#*:}; body=${body#*:}
    name=$(echo "$body" | sed -n 's/^func \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/p')
    [ -z "$name" ] && continue

    # cross-package qualified calls (all aliases), excluding comment-only lines
    cross_all=0; cross_nt=0
    for q in $quals; do
      c=$(grep -rlP --include='*.go' "\b${q}\.${name}\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./${dir}/" | while read -r f; do grep -cP "\b${q}\.${name}\(" "$f"; done | paste -sd+ | bc 2>/dev/null)
      [ -z "$c" ] && c=0
      cross_all=$((cross_all + c))
      c2=$(grep -rlP --include='*.go' "\b${q}\.${name}\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./${dir}/" | grep -v '_test.go' | while read -r f; do grep -cP "\b${q}\.${name}\(" "$f"; done | paste -sd+ | bc 2>/dev/null)
      [ -z "$c2" ] && c2=0
      cross_nt=$((cross_nt + c2))
    done

    # same-package unqualified calls: not preceded by . or word char, not a declaration, not comment
    same_all=$(grep -rhP --include='*.go' "(?<![\w.])${name}\(" "$dir" | grep -v '^func ' | grep -vP '^\s*//' | wc -l)
    same_nt=$(grep -rP --include='*.go' "(?<![\w.])${name}\(" "$dir" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '_test.go' | grep -v ':func ' | grep -vP ':\s*//' | wc -l)

    echo "$((cross_all+same_all))|$((cross_nt+same_nt))|${pkg}.${name}|$file|xall=$cross_all,sall=$same_all,xnt=$cross_nt,snt=$same_nt" >> /tmp/fanin2.txt
  done
done < /tmp/filepkg.txt

echo "### sorted by TOTAL (incl tests)"
sort -t'|' -k1,1nr /tmp/fanin2.txt | head -25
echo
echo "### sorted by NON-TEST"
sort -t'|' -k2,2nr /tmp/fanin2.txt | head -25

cd /bench/repo

: > /tmp/fanin2.txt

# qualifier aliases per package dir
qual_for() {
  case "$1" in
    internal/markdown/ast) echo "ast mast" ;;
    internal/markdown/parser) echo "parser mparser" ;;
    internal/ai/stt/openai) echo "openai sttopenai" ;;
    internal/ai/audiollm/gemini) echo "gemini audiollmgemini" ;;
    *) basename "$1" ;;
  esac
}

while IFS='|' read -r file pkg dir; do
  quals=$(qual_for "$dir")
  grep -n '^func [A-Za-z_]' "$file" | while IFS= read -r hit; do
    body=${hit#*:}; body=${body#*:}
    name=$(echo "$body" | sed -n 's/^func \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/p')
    [ -z "$name" ] && continue

    # cross-package qualified calls (all aliases), excluding comment-only lines
    cross_all=0; cross_nt=0
    for q in $quals; do
      c=$(grep -rlP --include='*.go' "\b${q}\.${name}\(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./${dir}/" | while read -r f; do grep -cP "\b${q}\.${name}\(" "$f"; done | paste -sd+ | bc 2>/dev/null)
      [ -z "$c" ] && c=0

  done
done < /tmp/filepkg.txt
